title: 2017 AMC 10A Problem 6
statement: Ms. Carroll promised that anyone who got all the multiple choice questions right on the upcoming exam would receive an A on the exam. Which one of these statements necessarily follows logically?

answerChoices.label: A
answerChoices.text:
If Lewis did not receive an A, then he got all of the multiple
choice questions wrong.

answerChoices.label: B
answerChoices.text:
If Lewis did not receive an A, then he got at
least one of the multiple choice questions wrong.

answerChoices.label: C
answerChoices.text:
If Lewis got at least one of the multiple choice questions
wrong, then he did not receive an A.

answerChoices.label: D
answerChoices.text:
If Lewis received an A, then he got all of the multiple choice
questions right.

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text:
If Lewis received an A, then he got at least one of the
multiple choice questions right.

solutions.text:
The promise says that getting every multiple choice question right guarantees an A. Its contrapositive is that anyone who did not receive an A must not have gotten every multiple choice question right. In other words, that person got at least one multiple choice question wrong.

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Translate the promise as an implication
Use the contrapositive of the statement
